title.zh: 归一化相对论协动广义谱

summary: Assemble and solve the declared normalized relativistic co-drift generalized spectrum for typed species and ky=0 wavevectors, returning complete per-wavevector modes in two independent orderings.

capability: Solve the bounded normalized species-and-wavevector generalized spectrum.
operation: assemble and solve a 4*S+6 generalized eigenproblem per wavevector
typed species and k -> complete real/imaginary ordered spectra
discovery.model: Normalized linearized co-drift generalized eigenproblem with optional relativistic tangent inertia; only c=epsilon0=mu0=B0=1 and zero collisions are supported.
discovery.geometry: Normalized wavevectors are [kx, ky, kz] with ky=0; species state order is [dn, ux, uy, uz] and six Maxwell fields follow.
discovery.boundary: The declared normalized constants, zero collision matrix and ky=0 branch are required; superluminal relativistic species and malformed dimensions fail before a result is returned.

identity.relation: typed normalized species and ky=0 wavevectors to complete co-drift frequency spectra
identity.direction: constants, relativistic flag, species and k -> per-k real_order and imag_order mode pairs
identity.definition: Build a 4*S+6 square matrix M and generalized mass matrix A for each k, solve M X=lambda A X, map omega=i lambda, and independently sort complete modes by descending real and imaginary parts.
identity.model: Normalized linearized relativistic co-drift generalized spectrum; the relativistic branch uses tangent inertia and the nonrelativistic branch uses A=I.
identity.geometry: Species-major state with six field entries; k is a row sequence of normalized [kx,ky,kz] vectors.
identity.coordinates: All quantities are dimensionless under c=epsilon0=mu0=B0=1. The declared wavevector coordinate order is [kx,ky,kz].
identity.boundary: Only the normalized constants, zero collision matrix and ky=0 wavevector branch are implemented; no fallback to another dispersion model is selected.
assumptions: Mass and density are positive and each species has three velocity and two density-gradient components.
The complete finite spectrum is returned per k; no physical mode identification or stability interpretation is inferred.

inputs.name: case
inputs.description: Typed normalized constants, species records, relativistic branch flag, collision selector and wavevectors.
inputs.constraints: constants must all equal 1; collision_matrix must be 'zero'; k is [N,3] with every ky=0; species fields follow the declared dimensions and positivity rules.

outputs.name: spectra
outputs.description: One complete spectrum record per input wavevector, each carrying real_order and imag_order arrays of real/imaginary pairs.
outputs.shape: list of N mappings; each order is [4*S+6,2]
outputs.dtype: nested Python lists of float pairs
outputs.constraints: Every returned pair is finite; real_order and imag_order are independent descending sorts of the same complete spectrum.

preconditions: The caller accepts the normalized constants and coordinate conventions.
Each species has positive mass/density, gamma_pressure=1, three velocity components and two density-gradient components.
Relativistic speeds are strictly below c; nonrelativistic mode skips the relativistic speed bound but retains positive mass/density and dimensions.
supported: The declared relativistic and nonrelativistic zero-collision branches for finite typed species and ky=0 wavevectors.
excluded: SI unit conversion, nonzero ky, nonzero collisions, arbitrary normalized constants or a general warm-fluid/covariant model.
Mode tracking, stability/convergence certification and physical correctness outside the retained source-fidelity fixtures.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for unsupported constants, nonzero collision matrix, ky != 0, invalid species dimensions, gamma_pressure != 1, nonpositive mass/density or relativistic speed >= c.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: SciPy generalized eigensolver or finite-spectrum checks propagate numerical failures; no fallback spectrum is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable as an exposed iterative state; an eigensolver failure propagates.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No spectrum mapping is returned after validation, eigensolver or finite-result failure.

example.description: An empty normalized wavevector list returns an empty spectrum list.
example.expected: The normalized constants and zero-collision branch validate, then the empty k list returns spectra=[].

scope: The candidate packet's valid relativistic and nonrelativistic host probes and explicit superluminal, ky-nonzero and collision-nonzero failures.
Three direct tests retain 14-mode shape, finite output, first-row source comparison and superluminal rejection.
verification.evidence_ceiling: D1 source-fidelity partial for the declared normalized path and listed failures. SciRel isolated image execution and native source runtime in the SciRel boundary are NOT_RUN; no physical correctness, covariant warm-fluid validity, stability guarantee, human scientific acceptance, rights acceptance or release is established.
known_limitations: Only c=epsilon0=mu0=B0=1, ky=0 and zero collision matrix are implemented.
The source fixture has two species and four wavevectors; arbitrary species and k domains remain unqualified.
The generalized eigensolver output is a complete numerical spectrum, not a physical mode classification or stability result.
SciRel isolated execution remains NOT_RUN per coordinator receipt.
The GPL-3.0-or-later license is retained but rights acceptance remains pending.
